calls.prompt: Create a premium 3D CREATURE MODEL DESIGN REVIEW BOARD for BugWorld, landscape 2048x1536, Chinese typography, luminous warm off-white studio background with very soft natural contact shadows. This is a concept of an actual volumetric game creature, not the delivered 3D file. Reference image 1 is the APPROVED 2D insect silhouette sheet and is authoritative for identity, contours and fixed markings. Reference image 2 is the APPROVED botanical lotus-wetland setting, only a secondary cue for naturalism, material quality and lighting. The goal: the user's hand-colored insect has come to life as a real small creature in nature, while the exact drawing remains recognizable. Build the surface and anatomy as organic curved volumes with natural limb attachments, restrained physically plausible material response, dimensional contact shadows and a convincing natural pose. KEEP the visible wax-crayon artwork as the insect's surface coloration, with fine dry wax grain and imperfect directional pigment strokes, not a paper cutout glued onto an unrelated photoreal animal. No toy, no plastic figurine, no balloon animal, no rigid cutout extrusion, no plush, no cartoon facial expression, no smile, no googly eyes, no anthropomorphic accessories. Wings thin where appropriate, bodies solid where appropriate, legs genuinely touch the surface, no excessive hairy horror details. Do not replace the approved silhouette with a common stock species. Consistent drawings and colors across ALL views of this same model. Board composition: top narrow title area; left 22% an unobtrusive 2D colored drawing of the EXACT approved shape seen in its original reference viewing direction, caption '画纸对应'; center-right dominant large naturally posed 3/4 dimensional model on a small realistic piece of leaf or bark, taking 58% of board, caption '立体主视角'; bottom-right smaller side or rear view on clean off-white background exposing thickness and limb structure, caption '体积与结构'. All views visually separated with generous whitespace, not boxed into a dashboard. Add a tiny footer '模型设计提案 · 非运行截图'. Sharp rich detail at natural scale, soft neutral light plus a restrained cool rim, no blur that hides anatomy, no dramatic dark background, no dimensions or invented mesh numbers. The 2D artwork must match the corresponding 3D view in color areas and markings; artistic examples only, colors remain user editable. SPECIES: BUTTERFLY. Heading 'BugWorld · 蝴蝶 3D 设计'. Approved shape is the TOP-LEFT butterfly in reference 1: upright slender dark brown segmented body, broad almost rounded-triangular upper wings, smoothly scalloped lower wings, tapered dark patches along the far upper OUTER corners, and one curved row of dark dots along the lower wing edges. Upper/lower wing outlines MUST remain as approved, no swallowtail tails or monarch-black vein patterns. The '画纸对应' view is upright top view, wings fully open; upper wings wax crayon rose-pink with lavender toward the roots, lower wings lavender with softly applied pink; each side has the same recognizable regions and intentionally imperfect crayon strokes, some cream-white paper-like pores visible. The 3D hero sits on the edge of a naturally curled bluish-green lotus leaf, viewed from front-right above so the back surfaces of ALL FOUR wings and their rounded contours can be seen, wings relaxed in a gentle shallow V. Wings must be thin delicate membranes with a subtle flexible arch, very restrained veins and tiny light-catching edge thickness, never thick carved foam or paper card. Slender thorax/abdomen have true rounded volume, restrained fine fuzz, six fine articulated legs attached to thorax and naturally gripping leaf, two slender slightly curved antennae, small natural dark eyes integrated into the head. The lower detail view is an oblique low side view showing the thin curved wings, cylindrical tapered abdomen and small leg contact points, with same coloration and markings. Black drawing outlines become natural dark edge pigment bands on wings, not a glowing contour in space. Keep the creature calm and alive, not an anatomical horror study.

refinements.prompt: Refine the attached BugWorld caterpillar 3D model design board. Image 1 is the design to edit; Image 2 is the approved 2D silhouette reference which remains authoritative. Make it read as a real living soft-bodied caterpillar, while keeping the user's colored drawing recognizable. Replace the thick crusted paper texture and raised crayon flakes with extremely fine, flat wax-pigment coloration ON continuous supple insect skin. Real skin has delicate fine folds and gentle satin light, soft subsurface shading, with uninterrupted skin bridges between segments; all pastel colors remain surface pigment. Body is a continuous flexible cylinder with subtle segment constrictions, not balls strung together, no thick rims at every segment, no knitted fabric, no carved foam, no paper layers, no clay, no dried-paint cracking, no fur.
